description: Scores a test utterance against a Cognigy.AI flow's trained NLU intents. Returns the best matching intent with confidence score. Use this to quickly test if an utterance would be recognized correctly.

flowId.description: The flow ID to score against (will be converted to reference ID)

localeId.description: Optional locale ID (will use flow's default if not provided)

projectId.description: The project ID containing the flow

threshold.description: Minimum score threshold to include in results (0-1, default 0.4)

name: score_utterance
